formats.label: Walkthrough
formats.summary: Every screen of the subject in order; its length follows the content.

formats.label: Promo
formats.summary: The problem, the subject in action, the outcome.

formats.label: Trailer
formats.summary: Highlights across a module or flow, in acts with act cards.

formats.label: Store preview
formats.summary: 30 s or less, with an end card of 2 s or less.

formats.label: How-to
formats.summary: One task in numbered steps, at calm pacing.

options.label: Floating desk
options.preview: The app's window floats on a calm ground, with room around it for captions.

options.label: Full-bleed app
options.preview: The app fills the frame; captions sit in clear space over it.

options.label: Split caption panel
options.preview: The app on one side of the frame, the captions in a panel on the other.

options.label: Device frame
options.preview: The app inside a laptop or phone frame.

options.label: Light
options.preview: A light ground, tinted with the brand's colours.

options.label: Deep brand
options.preview: A deep ground in the brand's main colour.

options.label: Focus-pop with chip and leader
options.preview: The rest of the app blurs and dims, the target lifts in a card, and a caption chip points at its edge.

options.label: Chip and leader only
options.preview: A caption chip with a leader to the target; nothing blurs.

options.label: Numbered steps
options.preview: Each step's target gets a numbered badge, with its caption beside it.

options.label: Subtitle bar
options.preview: Captions run in a bar along the bottom of the frame.

options.label: Cursor with click ripple, pinned
options.preview: A cursor moves to each control, ripples on a click, and stays on its target while the camera moves.

options.label: None
options.preview: No cursor; each control shows its own pressed state.

options.label: Touch taps
options.preview: A fingertip ring taps each control.

options.label: Glide between shots
options.preview: The camera glides from one shot to the next.

options.label: Cut between shots
options.preview: Each shot cuts straight to the next.

options.label: Standard
options.preview: Each callout holds 1.4 s.

options.label: Calm
options.preview: Each callout holds 1.6 s; the how-to default.

options.label: Brisk
options.preview: Each callout holds 1.2 s; the teaser and trailer default.

options.label: Boom
options.preview: The logo pops and the title lands on the beat, with one ring and a hit.

options.label: Calm logo reveal
options.preview: The logo fades up, then the title under it.

options.label: Splash into the app
options.preview: The logo opens straight into the first screen.

options.label: None
options.preview: The end card has no status chip.

options.label: New
options.preview: A New chip, in the design system's info colours.

options.label: Beta
options.preview: A Beta chip, in the design system's info colours.

options.label: Coming soon
options.preview: A Coming soon chip, in the design system's info colours.

options.label: On
options.preview: The end card says "Shown with demo data".

options.label: Off
options.preview: The end card says nothing about the data.

options.label: Score on the beat
options.preview: A score cut to the beats, with effects on clicks and pops.

options.label: Silent
options.preview: No sound.

options.label: As is
options.preview: The app exactly as it is.

options.label: As designed
options.preview: Listed fixes are applied in the film and handed to the app team as a list.

patterns.label: Column sweep
patterns.preview: The focus sweeps across a table's columns, one at a time.

patterns.label: Section tour
patterns.preview: The camera visits a dashboard's sections in turn.

patterns.label: Tab tour
patterns.preview: About 4 s on each tab, with its tab lit.

patterns.label: Focused typing
patterns.fits: a form or a text field
patterns.preview: The field being typed into is the focus, with the app's own focus outline.

patterns.label: Dialog step-through
patterns.preview: A dialog or drawer opens, and its parts are shown one at a time.

patterns.label: Hand-off across screens
patterns.preview: An action on one screen shows up on the next.

patterns.label: Before and after counters
patterns.preview: A number is shown before an action and after it.

patterns.label: Row pop-in
patterns.preview: A new row pops into a list.

patterns.label: Timeline build
patterns.preview: A timeline builds up one event at a time.
